name: custom-controls-customer
description: Template for customer-owned frontend artefacts served to abap2UI5

scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.auto_downport: (abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc || true) && npm run syfixes && npm run strip_trailing_ws && abaplint .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc && cp -f .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc abaplint.jsonc && npm run abaplintpathfix
scripts.check:js: for f in $(find app/webapp -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:bsp: npm run app2bsp && git diff --exit-code -- src
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:cloud && npm run check:js && npm run check:bsp

renameSkip.src/01/: the BSP Z2UI5_CCC (WAPA) and its two ICF nodes - abaplint 2.120.120 has no WAPA renamer (abap2UI5 backlog item abaplint-rename-wapa, abaplint PR #4721), and the abap2UI5 frontend reserves the resource root z2ui5_ccc; install the BSP unrenamed

renameLiterals.z2ui5_ccc: z2ui5_cl_ccc=>c_ns, the resource root of the BSP that src/01 keeps unrenamed (abaplint-rename-wapa)
